facts.text: Park Hyatt Kuala Lumpur occupies the top floors of Menara Merdeka Maybank (Merdeka 118).
facts.excerpt: occupying the top floors of Menara Merdeka Maybank

facts.text: The hotel's restaurants and bar, Park Lounge, Merdeka Grill and Cacao Mixology & Chocolate, are on Level 75.

facts.text: At Merdeka Grill, dinner is served course by course, with signature dishes prepared or finished tableside.
